title: Beef patties with braised Little Gem and peas

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything is a whole food or cupboard staple, and the chicken stock counts as good stock.

supermarket.reason: Beef mince, Little Gems, butter beans, frozen peas and crème fraîche are all everyday Tesco items.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a lidded frying pan and a bowl, and the techniques are simple shaping, browning and simmering.

works.reason: 500g mince makes eight small patties for four, browning then a covered 10-minute simmer cooks them through, and 300ml stock suits a braise of beans, peas and lettuce.

honest_times.reason: Slicing spring onions, shaping patties and halving lettuces fits 20 minutes of prep, and 6 plus 3 plus 10 minutes in the steps matches the 20-minute cook time.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used in the steps, and Little Gem is a fair name for lettuce.

seasonal_feel.reason: Warm braised lettuce in stock is a sensible late-October way to use the hero, and the lettuce is a main part of the dish rather than a garnish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear and in plain British English.

hearty_healthy.reason: It is a balanced family dinner of beef, beans, peas and greens.
